pages.text: Organs: $(l)heart$(), $(l)lungs$(), $(l)liver$(), $(l)kidneys$(), $(l)intestines$(), $(l)spleen$(). Damaged by chest and abdominal wounds, sepsis, lack of oxygen.

Up to $(cfg)50%$() they heal by themselves, worse — only a surgeon. Lungs — lower SpO₂; liver — more bleeding; kidneys — the brain suffers; heart — lower pressure; intestines at 100% — peritonitis and sepsis; spleen — abdominal bleeding, without it infections are worse.
$(l)Removal$(): the scalpel (in the inventory) cuts the ligaments, the organ goes into a container. The brain can be removed too — that is death, even from clinical death.
$(l)Transplant$(): place the donor organ and suture the vessel. A different blood type — $(l)rejection$(): cyclosporine every 12 h. An organ spoils in $(cfg)1$() h when warm, never in a fridge.
